card_sentences: SAMPLE A family in Astoria has made halvah since 1998. They wanted a snack bar that tastes like the one their grandmother sold at the corner store.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE CONTAINS: SESAME, MILK, WHEAT, SOY, EGGS, PEANUTS AND TREE NUTS (ALMONDS, CASHEWS, PISTACHIOS, HAZELNUTS, WALNUTS, PECANS). ALSO CONTAINS FISH (ANCHOVY) AND CRUSTACEAN SHELLFISH (SHRIMP, CRAB).
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE MAY CONTAIN TRACES OF MUSTARD. MADE ON SHARED EQUIPMENT THAT ALSO PROCESSES OTHER TREE NUTS, OATS AND CELERY.
retailer_line: SAMPLE Whole Foods Market, 4 Union Square South
